sloka: हरीणाम् तरणे राम करिष्यामि यथास्थलम् ।तमब्रवीत्तदा रामः शृणु मे वरुणालय ॥६-२२-२९॥।।
transliteration: harīṇām taraṇe rāma kariṣyāmi yathāsthalam ।tamabravīttadā rāmaḥ śṛṇu me varuṇālaya ॥6-22-29॥।।

translations.english: Then Rama said, "O abode of Varuna, listen to me. In which location should I allow this unfailing mighty arrow to descend?"
